title: Efficient Exact Unlearning for Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated zeroth-order optimization (FedZOO) reduces the memory and communication costs of collaborative training for edge intelligence by avoiding backpropagation while communicating only random seeds and scalar coefficients. However, existing methods lack efficient mechanisms for exact unlearning to fully remove the influence of training data when users request deletion. A key insight is that total variation stability of the learning algorithm creates overlap between model distributions before and after data deletion, allowing exact unlearning to reuse computation through coupling. Based on this observation, we jointly design two stable zeroth-order learning algorithms and their corresponding exact-unlearning procedures: \textsc{FedZOO-S} obtains stability through client and mini-batch subsampling, enabling \textsc{FedZOUL-S} to perform efficient unlearning by preserving earlier updates and restarting from the first affected step. \t

translated_title: 面向联邦零阶优化的高效精确遗忘方法
translated_abstract: 联邦零阶优化通过避免反向传播，仅传输随机种子和标量系数，降低了边缘智能协作训练的内存与通信开销。然而，现有方法缺乏高效的精确遗忘机制，无法在用户请求删除数据时完全消除其训练数据的影响。一个关键洞察是：学习算法的总变差稳定性使得数据删除前后的模型分布存在重叠，从而允许精确遗忘通过耦合来复用已有计算。基于这一观察，我们联合设计了两个稳定的零阶学习算法及其对应的精确遗忘流程：FedZOO-S 通过客户端采样和小批量子采样获得稳定性，使得 FedZOUL-S 能够通过保留早期更新并从第一个受影响的步骤重新开始，从而实现高效的遗忘。
tldr: 该论文利用零阶学习算法的总变差稳定性实现删除前后模型分布的重叠与计算复用，提出稳定的 FedZOO-S 算法及其精确遗忘流程 FedZOUL-S，为联邦零阶优化提供了高效的精确数据遗忘机制。
en_tdlr: This paper exploits the total variation stability of zeroth-order learning algorithms to create distributional overlap for computation reuse, proposing a stable FedZOO-S algorithm and its corresponding FedZOUL-S procedure for efficient exact unlearning in federated zeroth-order optimization.
